title: Kontact Consortium India Pvt
description: kontact.in zoominfo.com/c/kontact-consortium-india-pvt-ltd/437934184 Kontact is an Indian engineering company with over 50 years of experience, specializing in electrical and mechanical solutions for the railway, infrastructure, and industrial sectors.
